architecture: Two-layer ConvLSTM, 64 hidden channels, 3x3 kernels, dilation 2, padding 2. Same pixel_unshuffle(4), 1x1 head, pixel_shuffle, sigmoid, and 9-step closed-loop rollout as Model A. No attention.
validation_note: Only the dilated ConvLSTM was implemented. No second candidate was trained, so there are no short validation losses. Videos 8000-8999 were not read.
count_method: sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
reach_path: u_tau -> layer-1 3x3 dilation 2 (2 folded cells) -> h1_tau -> layer-2 3x3 dilation 2 (2 folded cells) -> 1x1 head and pixel_shuffle (0 cells) -> prediction
